Could not find compatible versions

Because every version of c depends on y < 3
  and a < 2.0 depends on c >= 2.0.a,
  a < 2.0 requires y < 3.
And because a < 2.0 depends on y >= 3,
  a < 2.0 cannot be used.
So, because a >= 2.0 depends on b >= 3
  and b >= 3 could not be found in rubygems repository @SOURCE@/ or installed locally,
  version solving has failed.
